hypothesis: Matched-horizon reference for the seed-22 data_seed 0 ceiling test. Setup: m2 fixed at 0.5, N=64, seed 22, 4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], best-of-3 controls, 24000 steps. Prediction: the final layer-1 trained force R2 (probes_final, unrounded) stays at least 0.04 above the same-layer 24000-step N=128 seed-22 layer-1 value of 0.6903 (run-20261015-214139-70d4). The best-layer gap against that run's best layer (layer 3, 0.70462) is also reported and flagged as cross-layer if the layers differ. Intermediate values are read only as same-layer control plus margin. Horizon check: the step-12000 layer-1 value must be within 0.03 of the 12000-step N=64 seed-22 run's layer-1 value of 0.8398 (run-20261014-043150-f21c). If it is not, the result is reported as horizon-confounded. Both reference run IDs are cited as evidence.
expected_if_true: Final N=64 layer-1 trained force R2 >= 0.7303 (same-layer gap >= 0.04 vs 0.6903) and >= 0.7446 (best-layer gap >= 0.04 vs 0.70462), force margin >= 0.1, horizon check passes, and the accel_step headroom-normalised margin is in [0.60, 0.85].
expected_if_false: Final N=64 layer-1 trained force R2 <= 0.7103 (same-layer gap <= 0.02). That would mean N=64 force fell back to the N=128 level at the longer horizon, so the earlier gap was a horizon mismatch. A gap in (0.02, 0.04) is inconclusive.
